stem.text: An electric car travels at a constant speed of $70\,\text{km h}^{-1}$ for $80\,\text{km}$ on a straight horizontal road and uses energy $E$ from its battery.
The total resistive force acting on the car is proportional to (speed)$^{2}$. Assume that the electric motor is 100% efficient.
How much energy is used from the battery when the car travels at a constant speed of $60\,\text{km h}^{-1}$ for $80\,\text{km}$ on the straight horizontal road?
